audience: HR teams that keep their CultureMonkey employee directory up to date

useCases.title: Read the employee directory page by page
useCases.text: Read the directory one page at a time, 100 employees per page, until the last page. Open one employee by its external_id.

useCases.title: Add a new hire to the directory
useCases.text: Add an employee with a first name, an email, an external_id, a team and a location. Create the manager first, because the manager must already exist.

useCases.title: Change an employee's team or designation
useCases.text: Change only the fields you pass for one employee, found by its external_id. The external_id itself cannot change.

useCases.title: Offboard an employee who left
useCases.text: Deactivate one employee by external_id. This is a soft delete: the history stays, and no more surveys are sent to that person.
